purpose: Collect the clean full-push calibration required to describe circuit C before any Bahrain LICO outcome is observed or any zero-LICO-shot prediction is frozen.

sessions.objective: Obtain five clean consecutive full-push laps for Bahrain braking, approach-speed, acceleration and local fuel/time references.
sessions.lico_variation_guidance: No intentional LICO, lift-and-coast or fuel-saving action. Normal throttle modulation required to drive corners is not LICO.
sessions.execution_quality_notes: Retain every recorded lap. Mark impacts, off-tracks, missed braking points, spins, traffic-like interruptions and abnormal slowdowns by lap and corner; use zone-level exclusions when an otherwise useful lap has one localized error.
sessions.notes: Start with 55 L, Oreca 07 LMP2, standard Grand Prix layout, constant weather, zero tire wear and one unchanged setup. Drive five scored laps; up to two replacement laps are allowed, for seven scored laps maximum, if an error occurs. No live cue runner or beep is used.

sessions.objective: Prospectively test the frozen Spa-plus-Paul zero-LICO-shot response on six Bahrain zones while collecting same-session push controls.
sessions.lico_variation_guidance: Fixed seven-lap P/L/L/P/L/L/P schedule. On each LICO lap, fully release at every beep and coast to the normal braking point. The same static zone plan is repeated on all four LICO laps; action distance varies between zones, not between laps.
sessions.execution_quality_notes: Record all cues, misses and localized errors. Preserve clean phase-specific signals; do not convert one corner error into a whole-lap exclusion. Native LMU DuckDB recording and LICOR live telemetry logging are mandatory.
sessions.notes: Frozen before any Bahrain LICO outcome. Six cues per LICO lap, 24 expected beeps. T05-T07 and T13 remain silent validation-only zones.
